name: Dance of the Manse — returned permanents are 4/4 creatures only if X is 6 or more
notes: Sweep cast-condition leftovers (2026-10-06). "Return up to X target artifact and/or non-Aura enchantment cards … to the battlefield. If X is 6 or more, those permanents are 4/4 creatures in addition to their other types." produced nothing. The second sentence is now a branch line "If [6 is 6 or more], Up to 6 target artifacts and/or non-Aura enchantments are 4/4 creatures in addition to their other types." — the subject comes from the cards the first sentence returned. X = 6 on Darksteel Ingot and Leyline of Sanctity: both 4/4 creatures that keep their types. X = 5 on Sol Ring: still not a creature.
